defects_argued.quote: Considering the facts that all the notices were uploaded in the portal under the "view additional notices/orders" and therefore, the petitioner had no occasion to view the said column
and the impugned order was passed without affording an opportunity to the petitioner to establish his case before the authorities concerned, which is violation of principles of natural justice

outcome.quote: the delay of 25 days in filing the appeal is condoned and the respondent is directed to take the appeal on record and pass orders on merits and in accordance with law.
